[support-power-of-attorney] Power of attorney (effective 2025-01-01)
If you have power of attorney for a Tallowbrook member, our Account Services team can add you to their account as an agent.

## What we need

- A copy of the power of attorney document, signed and in effect
- Your government-issued photo ID
- Your contact details

## How to send it

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject Power of attorney, or ask the account holder to message support from their session. Support can't review the documents. They go to Account Services.

## How long it takes

Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm

[support-power-of-attorney] Power of attorney (effective 2025-01-01)
How long it takes

Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received, and may ask for more information.

## Until it's approved

We can't share information or take instructions from you until Account Services has approved the document. That includes freezing cards or changing plans.

## If the account holder is in danger

If you think the account holder is being exploited financially, tell us. We treat that as urgent.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[support-third-parties] Can someone else manage my account? (effective 2025-01-01)
account.

## Helping someone with their account

The account holder can sit with you and message us from their own session. We'll talk to them directly.

## Legal authority

If you have power of attorney, or you're handling the account of someone who has died, we can help through our Account Services team. See "Power of attorney" and "If an account holder has died".

## If you think someone is misusing your account

If someone else is using your account without your permission, or pressuring you over your money, tell us in the app. See "If

[support-what-we-can-do] What our support team can help with (effective 2025-01-01)
and nothing is pending or disputed
- Explain fees, limits and policies

## Support passes to a specialist team

- **Fraud:** suspected account takeover, removing a fraud lock, scam payments
- **Disputes:** disputes above the support limit
- **Verification:** identity checks, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- **Account Services:** power of attorney, a deceased account holder, financial abuse
- **Complaints:** formal complaints

Specialist teams reply within 2 business days.

## Support can't

- Act

[docs-verification-letter] Account verification letter (effective 2025-01-01)
An account verification letter confirms that you have an open account with us. Landlords, employers and government offices sometimes ask for one.

## Get a letter

Tap Profile, then Documents, then Account verification letter. The PDF is ready right away and shows your name, account number, account type and the date the account was opened.

## Showing your balance

You can choose whether the letter includes your current balance.

## Custom letters

We can't write custom letters, sign forms, or fill in third-party verification forms. The standard letter is accepted by most organizations.

## Closed accounts

Letters are only available

[products-joint-accounts] Do you offer joint accounts? (effective 2025-01-01)
you have power of attorney, see "Power of attorney". Otherwise, we can only talk to the account holder.

## Will you offer joint accounts?

We don't have plans to share right now.

## Couples and roommates

Splitting a bill is easy with BrookPay. One person pays, and the other sends their share straight from the app. BrookPay has no fee and arrives in seconds.

## Moving money from a joint account elsewhere

You can link a joint account you hold at another bank as an external account, as long as your name is on it.

Still stuck?

[docs-verification-letter] Account verification letter (effective 2025-01-01)
standard letter is accepted by most organizations.

## Closed accounts

Letters are only available for open accounts. For a closed account, use your final statement.

## Someone else asking

We don't confirm account details to landlords, employers or anyone else who contacts us directly. Give them the letter yourself.

## Is it official?

Yes. The letter carries a verification code that the recipient can check on our help center.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

request.instructions:
You are the resolver agent on the support team of Tallowbrook, a US neobank. You decide what support should do about a ticket and write it as an action plan. You can read the customer's account and ask the customer one clarifying question. You can't make changes. An executor applies your plan only after a human approves it.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Tools you can call (none of them change the account):
- ask_customer(question): ask the customer one clarifying question
- get_customer_profile(): plan, status, billing dates of the customer
- list_accounts(): the customer's accounts and balances
- list_cards(): the customer's cards (id, kind, status, last4)
- list_disputes(): the customer's disputes
- list_transactions(limit=40): recent transactions, newest first

Actions a plan can contain:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Rules for the plan:
- Include only actions the policy allows and the ticket needs. If the policy says no, include no action and explain why in the reply.
- Use exact ids from the tools (card_id, txn_id). Never guess an id.
- If the case must go to a specialist team, include escalate_to_human with the right queue.
- Today is 2026-09-15.

Each turn, reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Either a tool call:
{"type": "tool", "tool": "<tool name>", "args": {...}}
or your final plan:
{"type": "plan", "plan": {"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}, "why": "..."}], "reply_to_customer": "...", "rationale": "...", "policy_refs": ["<article_id>"]}}
